UserObject.label: pgvector: Clinical RAG Pipeline -- 1. PDF guidelines ingested into sources 2. Chunked with overlap (512 tokens, 50 overlap) 3. Each chunk embedded via local model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, CPU, no API needed) 4. HNSW index for sub-10ms similarity search 5. Doctor query -> embed -> top_k chunks -> LLM context -- SQL: SELECT chunk_text, 1 - (chunk_text_embedding <=> query_vec) FROM clinical_document_chunks WHERE source_id = ANY(guideline_ids) ORDER BY chunk_text_embedding <=> query_vec LIMIT 5;
